name: war-bonds-backwards
why: Opens on the poster spinning to BUY BONDS · KILL DISEASES and the 272% bar climbing off the paper past Grandma's 3%, then pays off with Grandma's bill getting Hitler (not his moustache) and the same film run backwards into a germ.

name: not-a-ponzi-scheme
why: The objection itself is the hook, Ponzi's pyramid runs out of people and falls on him, the money turns out to come off the bomb heap, and the drug rep talks a germ to death: same weapon, different enemy.

name: requires-being-warren-buffett
why: A 272% bar goes through the ceiling with a smoking politician on top, every ordinary investment gets its own catch, and it ends on YOU trying on Warren Buffett's glasses to no effect.
